episodes.title: Revival of the Rumble
episodes.summary: Jason's journey begins with inspiration from iconic vintage hill climbers.

episodes.title: Painting With Light
episodes.summary: Jason meets his personal hero and one of his top creative inspirations: renowned photographer Todd Hido.

episodes.title: Forging a Family
episodes.summary: Jason collaborates with various artists when crafting his characters for the silver screen.

episodes.title: Heart of the Machine
episodes.summary: Jason, Jeremiah Armenta and Max Schaaf embark on a journey of camaraderie and craftsmanship, forging an unbreakable bond. Through the trials and triumphs of their labor of love, they breathe new life into a fleet of '36 Knucklehead choppers.

episodes.title: The Instrument of Legends
episodes.summary: Jason's journey takes him to Gibson; he rebuilds some iconic instruments that influence the music he loves and uncovers the stories behind them.

episodes.title: The Phantom and the Electric Way
episodes.summary: Jason, with his heart in the past and his mind looking to the future, converts vintage vehicles to electric -- including a 1920s Rolls Royce.

episodes.title: Musician and the Craftsmen
episodes.summary: Jason collaborates with Les Claypool and Fender's Master Builders to build a line of guitars.

episodes.title: The Holy Grails
episodes.summary: Jason, inspired to discover more when he finds himself at the feet of a Holy Grail piece, sets off on a quest to locate others.

episodes.title: The Bobby Lees
episodes.summary: After one of his favorite bands announces an indefinite hiatus due to the changing music industry, Jason sets out to help them sign a record label.

episodes.title: Julian Schnabel
episodes.summary: Jason lives out his dream of creating art with one of his longtime heroes – and personal friend – artist/filmmaker Julian Schnabel.

episodes.title: The War Pigs
episodes.summary: For his most anticipated trip, Jason scours Japan for super elusive "War Pigs" in hopes of bringing as many bikes as he can back to Harley-Davidson.

episodes.title: Off the Grid
episodes.summary: Jason challenges Electrogenics to outfit a vintage bike with hybrid gear while spotlighting an EV trailblazer developing solar panels for catamarans.

episodes.title: History of Speed
episodes.summary: Jason returns to Wheels of Time with an even bigger idea: recreating – and then racing – one of Harley Davidson's most legendary bikes.

episodes.title: The Explorer & The Flying V
episodes.summary: In 1958, Gibson released the ultra-rare Flying V and Explorer guitars. Now, Jason sets out to track down some of the world's most sought-after ones.
